mapper.sql: vendor_contacts.id AS id, vendor_contacts.contact_name AS contactName, vendor_contacts.vendor_id AS vendorId, vendors.name AS vendorName, vendor_contacts.sex AS sex, vendor_contacts.contact_telephone AS contactTelephone, vendor_contacts.contact_email AS contactEmail, vendor_contacts.note AS note, vendor_contacts.created AS created, CONCAT(users1.first_name, ' ', users1.last_name) AS createdBy, vendor_contacts.modified AS modified, CONCAT(users2.first_name, ' ', users2.last_name) AS modifiedBy

FROM vendor_contacts LEFT JOIN vendors ON vendors.id = vendor_contacts.vendor_id LEFT JOIN users AS users1 ON users1.id = vendor_contacts.created_by LEFT JOIN users AS users2 ON users2.id = vendor_contacts.modified_by
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO vendor_contacts ( sys_code, contact_name, vendor_id, sex, contact_telephone, contact_email, note, created, created_by, is_active ) VALUES ( UUID(), #{vendorContact.contactName}, #{vendorContact.vendorId}, #{vendorContact.sex}, #{vendorContact.contactTelephone}, #{vendorContact.contactEmail}, #{vendorContact.note}, NOW(), #{vendorContact.createdBy}, #{vendorContact.isActive} )
mapper.update: UPDATE vendor_contacts SET contact_name = #{vendorContact.contactName}, vendor_id = #{vendorContact.vendorId}, sex = #{vendorContact.sex}, contact_telephone = #{vendorContact.contactTelephone}, contact_email = #{vendorContact.contactEmail}, note = #{vendorContact.note}, modified = NOW(), modified_by = #{vendorContact.modifiedBy} WHERE id = #{vendorContact.id}
